description_en: Queries the historical prices of spot instances. You can retrieve data from the last 30 days. The historical price data helps you set a reasonable maximum price per spot instance
description_zh: 本接口用于查询抢占式实例的历史价格，最多支持获取近30天内的数据，通过历史价格数据可以帮助您合理的设置抢占式实例的单台实例上限价格
kebab_example: aliyun ecs describe-spot-price-history --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --network-type vpc --instance-type ecs.t1.xsmall --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSpotPriceHistory

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 实例所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The network type of the spot instance. Valid values:

vpc: VPC.
classic: classic network. This feature is retired. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2833134.html
parameters.help_zh:
抢占式实例网络类型。取值范围：

vpc：专有网络。
classic：经典网络。该功能已下线，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2833134.html
parameters.name: network_type

parameters.help_en:
The protection period of the spot instance. Unit: hours. Default value: 1. Valid values:
1: Alibaba Cloud guarantees that the instance is not automatically released within 1 hour after it is created. After 1 hour, the system automatically compares your bid with the market price and checks resource inventory to determine whether to retain or revoke the instance.
0: Alibaba Cloud does not guarantee that the instance runs for 1 hour after it is created. The system automatically compares your bid with the market price and checks resource inventory to determine whether to retain or revoke the instance.

Alibaba Cloud sends you a notification through an ECS system event 5 minutes before the instance is revoked. Spot instances are billed by the second. Select an appropriate protection period based on the execution duration of specific tasks.

This parameter takes effect only when SpotStrategy is set to SpotWithPriceLimit or SpotAsPriceGo
parameters.help_zh:
抢占式实例的保留时长，单位为小时。 默认值：1。取值范围：
1：创建后阿里云会保证实例运行1小时不会被自动释放；超过1小时后，系统会自动比较出价与市场价格、检查资源库存，来决定实例的持有和回收。
0：创建后，阿里云不保证实例运行1小时，系统会自动比较出价与市场价格、检查资源库存，来决定实例的持有和回收。

实例回收前5分钟阿里云会通过ECS系统事件向您发送通知。抢占式实例按秒计费，建议您结合具体任务执行耗时来选择合适的保留时长。

当SpotStrategy值为SpotWithPriceLimit或SpotAsPriceGo时该参数生效
parameters.name: spot_duration

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the spot instance is an I/O optimized instance. Valid values:

optimized: The spot instance is an I/O optimized instance.

none: The spot instance is a non-I/O optimized instance.

Default value for Generation I instances: none.

Default value for other instance family types: optimized
parameters.help_zh:
是否为I/O优化实例。取值范围：

optimized：表示抢占式实例为I/O优化实例。

none：表示抢占式实例为非I/O优化实例。

系列I实例默认值：none。

其余实例规格族默认值：optimized
parameters.name: io_optimized

parameters.help_en:
The start time to query the historical prices of spot instances. The time span between the start time and the specified end time cannot exceed 30 days. Specify the time in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html standard in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format. The time must be in UTC.

Default value: empty. An empty value indicates 3 hours before the end time
parameters.help_zh:
查询抢占式实例历史价格的起始时间，最大值不得超过指定的结束时间30天。按照https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html标准表示，并使用UTC +0时间，格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`。

默认值：空，空代表结束时间前3小时
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time to query the historical prices of spot instances. Specify the time in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html standard in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format. The time must be in UTC.

Default value: empty. An empty value indicates the current time
parameters.help_zh:
查询抢占式实例历史价格的结束时间。按照https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html标准表示，并使用UTC +0时间，格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`。

默认值：空，空表示当前时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The operating system platform of the instance. Valid values:

linux
windows
parameters.help_zh:
操作系统的发行平台类型。取值范围：

linux。
windows
parameters.name: os_type

parameters.help_en:
The starting row for the query.

Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始行。

默认值：0
parameters.name: offset

Currency.description_en:
The currency unit of the price.

China site: CNY.

International site: USD
Currency.description_zh:
价格的货币单位。

中国站：CNY。

国际站：USD

NextOffset.description_en: The starting row of the next page. You can use this value to query the next page of data by setting the `Offset` parameter to this value
NextOffset.description_zh: 下一页开始行，查询下一页的数据。参数`Offset`的指定值为该值
